# Sara Cunningham featured in Built In


November 10, 2026


Learning & Development Manager Sara Cunningham spoke with Built In about how Enova supports career growth on our customer experience team, from hands-on training and mentoring to stretch assignments: “Enova knows ‘growth’ means something different for everyone.”


Read the full article here:[What It’s Like to Grow as a Customer Success Professional at These 5 Companies](https://builtin.com/articles/what-its-like-to-grow-as-a-customer-success-professional-at-these-5-companies#Enova)
